title: AI-Driven Predictive Modelling for Food Shelf-Life Estimation and Spoilage Detection: Progress, Challenges, and Future Directions
content: Food spoilage nowadays is one of the major challenges faced by the global food industry, affecting product quality, consumer safety, and environmental sustainability. Traditional methods for determining shelf life and detecting spoilage are often time-consuming, labor-intensive, and unable to provide real-time information. Recent advances in artificial intelligence have emerged as an effective solution, offering faster and more accurate approaches to predicting food shelf-life and early spoilage detection. By combining data from sensors, imaging systems, laboratory analyses, and environmental monitoring tools, artificial intelligence models can recognize complex patterns that are difficult to detect using conventional methods. This review examines recent advances in artificial intelligence driven predictive modelling for food shelf-life estimation and spoilage detection across a wide range of food products, including dairy, meat, seafood, fruits, and vegetables. Particular attention is given to machine learning and deep learning techniques such as artificial neural networks, support vector machines, random forests, and convolutional neural networks, which have demonstrated strong predictive performance in food quality assessment. The review also discusses how artificial intelligence technologies can support real-time monitoring, improve supply chain management, reduce food waste, and enhance consumer confidence in food safety. Although these benefits are significant, several challenges continue to limit large-scale implementation, including limited availability of high-quality datasets, concerns regarding model transparency, sensor-related constraints, high costs, and regulatory considerations. In summary, the use of artificial intelligence driven predictive modelling to assess the shelf-life of food and detect spoilage is a valuable innovation that can have a major impact on the future of the food industry.
